scope: Offline joint body/material evaluation. No training, ONNX export, runtime integration or changed solver acceptance.

policy.phase: One global A/B exchange per image, selected on every known material pixel and retained for joint scoring.
policy.missingBody: Always an error on known material; never excluded from denominator.
policy.unknownMaterial: Excluded from joint classes but retained in the body task when body is known.
policy.fractionalCoverage: Expected hard-classification disagreement without target thresholding.
policy.scope: Known regions only; not crop, complete-boundary, graph or physical-template accuracy.
